title: Crispy Honey Pistachio Baklava Bites
hookLine: 40 paper-thin buttered phyllo layers packed with spiced pistachios & lemon-honey syrup.

items.name: Thawed phyllo pastry sheets + 3/4 cup butter

steps.title: Heat Oil & Prep Cooling Rack
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour neutral frying oil into a heavy pot to 2 inches deep and heat steadily to 350°F (175°C). Set a wire cooling rack over paper towels nearby and measure out {phyllo_bk} and {nuts_bk} so everything is ready to fry cleanly.

steps.title: Stack Buttered Phyllo & Nuts
steps.instructionTemplate: Layer brushed {phyllo_bk} sheets with spiced {nuts_bk} in thirds, then score diamonds before baking. Keep {phyllo_bk} and {nuts_bk} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Bake Golden & Pour Cold Syrup
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30 mins until golden crisp. Pour cold {honey_bk} immediately over hot baklava so it crackles. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 12 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {honey_bk}. Serve Crispy Honey Pistachio Baklava Bites fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 45 mins.
